summary: Academy Sports & Outdoors, Inc. filed a Form 8-K reporting results of its 2026 Annual Meeting of Stockholders. Stockholders voted on three items: election of Class III directors (Ken Hicks, Beryl Raff, Jeff Tweedy elected), ratification of Deloitte as auditor, and advisory say-on-pay approval, all passed with large majorities. The board also appointed Shannon Hennessy to the Compensation Committee and Clay Johnson to the Audit Committee. This is a routine ballot-report filing with no special situation; no transaction, activist campaign, or forced management change occurred. No watch items or risk-arb angle applicable.
